thesis: Onto Innovation (NYSE: ONTO), semiconductor inspection and metrology. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-09) read. Q3 revenue 409.7M (+87.8% y/y, +19.4% q/q), 9M 1,044.8M (+41.5%); Q3 gross margin 54.8%, operating income 95.4M vs 23.7M; Q3 NI 46.8M after a 40.8M unrealized Rigaku loss. In 2026 it issued 1.5B 0% convertible notes due 2031 (conversion 381.80), bought 27% of Rigaku for 719.5M (fair value 678.7M), repurchased 205M stock, and on 2026-11-16 authorized 400M more buyback. Cash and securities 1.25B. Close 170.16 (2026-11-20, -13.2% that day, cause not found) x 49,084k = 8.35B = 55x TTM NI 151.2M (about 43.5x ex Rigaku loss, own estimate), TTM FCF 247.6M (3.0%).
counterthesis: Four customers were 57% of 9M revenue (16.8, 14.5, 14.3, 11.5); revenue doubled off a weak prior-year quarter in a cyclical industry; valuation is high on earnings and FCF; OCF fell in 9M as receivables and inventory grew; the company now carries 1.5B of converts and a volatile Tokyo-listed stake; unexplained 13% one-day drop may signal customer or order news.
invalidation: Downgrade if orders or revenue fall sequentially, a top customer cuts spending, gross margin slips below about 50%, or the Rigaku stake and converts become a capital allocation drag; upgrade case needs sustained growth with lower multiple after the drop is explained.
